name: futu
description: Connect Futu to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Futu MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Futu to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with market data and portfolio using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Futu workspace.
Find anything in Futu that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review market data and portfolio in Futu.
